title: Local vanishing on affine opens for restricted lower tails
statement: Under the hypotheses of the local bound, for every affine open U of V, every p>0 and q<0, the displayed open module cohomology object of the q-th homology of the restricted lower truncation is zero.

proof.text: Identify the homology of the restricted lower truncation with the restricted homology sheaf below the cutoff and with zero at or above it, then transfer the positive open module cohomology vanishing from the source module-cohomology hypothesis using the module/abelian comparison.

mathlib_searches.query: derived restriction homology truncation affine open module cohomology vanishing

theorem affineBasisRestrictedLowerTail_local_vanishing
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wV} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (F : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
    (hhomology : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → W ≤ V → ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
      Subsingleton (((F.homology n).restrict W.ι).H (q + 1)))
    (a : ℤ) (U : Opens V.toScheme) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (q : ℤ) (hq : q < 0) :
    IsZero ((RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology V.toScheme.toRingedSpace p U).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) q).obj
        ((schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))).truncLT a).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj F)))))
